svg.title: Finite-grid estimates are compared with continuous Arb enclosures and conditional, sometimes vacuous, ideal-estimator error bounds.
svg.desc: Eight declared certification jobs use continuous independent A,A′ and D,D′ with source separation at least 0.2. Filled/open squares are outward-rounded Arb lower/upper enclosures; crosses are ordinary finite-grid estimates, not continuous lower bounds. Delay follows each method label. The small delay-four enclosure is also printed with endpoints rounded outwards to four decimals. Different enclosure widths reflect bounded verification work, so lower endpoints alone do not rank actual designs. The lower panel converts verified lower bounds to conservative chi-square-eight error bounds for an ideal exact global nearest-model estimator. The dashed 0.05 target is not achieved by any of these jobs. Hatched zero lower bounds remain unresolved, not exact aliases; numerical-optimizer errors are separate.
svg.title: Finite-grid estimates are compared with continuous Arb enclosures and conditional, sometimes vacuous, ideal-estimator error bounds.
